item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q010_rossmann_family_function_divergence","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08, the alcohol-dehydrogenase-like C-terminal domain, CoA-binding domain, and potassium-channel NAD-binding domain entries are three separate family-level nodes inside the same homologous superfamily. Specifically, Alcohol dehydrogenase-like, C-terminal domain is family c.2.1.1, SUNID 51736; CoA-binding domain is family c.2.1.8, SUNID 51900; and Potassium channel NAD-binding domain is family c.2.1.9, SUNID 63944. All three have the same parent, the c.2.1 NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains superfamily, SUNID 51735. That superfamily is under fold c.2, also named NAD(P)-binding Rossmann-fold domains, in class c, Alpha and beta proteins (a/b).\n\nThe interpretation is therefore remote homology within a Rossmann NAD(P)-binding superfamily, not identity of family or equivalence of function. SCOPe’s superfamily level implies a common evolutionary origin across c.2.1.1, c.2.1.8, and c.2.1.9, while their different fourth SCCS components mark them as distinct families within that superfamily. It is reasonable to transfer the broad Rossmann-like NAD(P)-binding-domain/template expectation across these families, but it would be unsafe to transfer the particular alcohol-dehydrogenase reaction, CoA/succinyl-CoA synthetase binding role, potassium-channel regulation role, substrate specificity, oligomeric context, or catalytic residues among them from SCOPe membership alone. For functional annotation or template choice, prefer family-level or closer sequence-cluster representatives; a sibling family in c.2.1 should be treated as a remote structural template whose active-site and ligand predictions need independent sequence, motif, ligand-bound structural, or biochemical evidence. Membership in the broader c.2 fold is weaker still and, by itself, should be read as shared Rossmann-fold architecture rather than a SCOPe homology assertion across different c.2 superfamilies.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51736","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51900","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/63944","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/51735/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.2.1/children?limit=20"]}]}
